questions.prompt: How are hidden reasoning (thinking) tokens billed by Anthropic, OpenAI and Google?

options.text: As output tokens, even when hidden.
options.explanation: Right. All three vendors bill reasoning as output.

options.text: They are free, because nobody sees them.
options.explanation: Hidden does not mean free. You pay for the full reasoning.
Reasoning is generated by the model, so it is billed as output.

questions.prompt: Which parameter sets how much a Gemini model thinks?

options.explanation: Right. Gemini uses thinking_level, for example low, medium or high.

questions.prompt: Thinking is off. How do the Claude docs suggest you get step-by-step reasoning and still parse the result?

options.text: Reason first, then put the final answer in answer tags to extract.
options.explanation: Right. This is the manual chain-of-thought fallback.

options.text: Set max_tokens very low so the model skips straight to its answer.
options.explanation: A low cap cuts the output; it does not change how the model reasons.
